purpose: Deliver a finite open v1.2 product release that provides bounded minimum-quality coverage across the material human-AI collaboration lifecycle, is actually installable and usable on Codex, preserves dynamic native-first capability and carrier adaptation, fills only evidenced residual gaps, survives controlled historical and adversarial counterexamples, and is reproducible and releasable with explicit human authority. The current shortfall corpus is a requirements and counterexample source rather than a feature backlog; coverage permits sufficient native or external reuse and honest degradation, escalation, stop or claim limitation instead of requiring a bespoke Harness mechanism or static perfect score. Natural-task burden reduction, broad real-world effectiveness, distinct-Agent equivalence, and untested operating-system behavior remain continuing field-validation claims rather than release-completion prerequisites. v0.2 remains an immutable bounded calibration milestone, while v1.0 and v1.1 remain immutable stopped zero-outcome attempts; none can satisfy this program by inheritance.

increments.observedProblem: O1 requires one non-duplicative disposition for every fixed SG-01 through SG-12 source slice with controlled evidence for each claimed effect. The exact validator and observed-native-minimum environment manifest now strictly precede registration, and the named human has accepted the applicability, accountable-domain boundary and bounded claim ceiling, but no immutable task registration or measured result exists.
increments.hypothesis: One immutable pre-measurement registration can bind the accepted twelve-slice mapping, exact source custody, environment, validator, safety floors and claim exclusions before any controlled execution; after a separate activation commit, the same task-specific validator can exercise and independently replay all twelve observable verifier effects without installing a plugin, invoking a model, manufacturing natural demand or creating a generic evidence runtime.
increments.falsifier: Registration is post-hoc, does not bind the exact accepted mapping or environment, reclassifies a slice, permits implementation or prose as proof, executes a scenario before the registration binding is valid, fails any controlled effect or independent replay, promotes controlled evidence into comparative burden, broad effectiveness, distinct-Agent or untested-platform claims, requires a new ungranted side effect, or leaves task-created residue.
increments.stopCondition: The immutable registration strictly precedes measurement; all twelve registered controlled scenarios and independent replay pass under the exact validator and environment binding; the named human accepts the bounded O1 result; O1 is verified without expanding its claim ceiling; the increment closes and all task-created temporary resources are absent.

deliverables: content-addressed twelve-slice observation and independently replayed evidence

increments.observedProblem: The committed O2 validator replays bounded public-safe projections but no exact code-owned builder yet converts native Codex plugin JSON, exec JSONL and task-owned filesystem state into those projections. Hand-authored projection bytes could therefore satisfy the replay shape without a source parser, so the validator is not ready for immutable registration.
increments.hypothesis: One task-specific, pure projection builder can consume bounded pre-existing native Codex JSON or JSONL and an isolated task root, reject unknown or private-bearing input, emit only the exact public schemas already replayed by the O2 validator, and bind its own committed identity without invoking Codex, a model, plugin installation or a persistent runtime.
increments.falsifier: The builder launches Codex or a model; installs, removes or configures a plugin; persists native raw events; accepts unknown event or plugin shapes, absolute paths, private identifiers, unbounded input or symlinked task files; emits an unbound or unreplayable schema; becomes a generic host runtime; weakens O2; or leaves task-created residue.
increments.stopCondition: The task-specific builder deterministically converts bounded native plugin-list JSON, exec JSONL and isolated filesystem fixtures into the exact public-safe projection schemas; the O2 registration validator requires its strict pre-registration revision and digest; negative tests reject private, unknown, oversized, symlinked and drifted inputs; focused tests and canonical verification pass with O1 true and O2 false; no Codex execution, plugin, account, private source or consumer configuration is touched.

deliverables: fail-closed projection and source-bound registration tests
